title: RegressionProfile
description: Hand-curated regression-injection profile per REPLY-52 D4. Derived from public postmortems; applied by tools/inject-regression.ts to mutate baseline sample series at a chosen T_inject tick. No ML inference on postmortem narratives — v1 profiles are hand-curated per architect anti-scope.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier; matches filename stem.

source.description: Human-readable provenance (e.g., 'OpenAI Dec 2024 routing incident postmortem').

duration_minutes.description: Total incident duration in minutes. Detection window per REPLY-52 §D5 = duration_minutes × ticks_per_min + sufficiency-gate bound.

affected_signals.description: Signal IDs that this regression touches. Used to scope the injection walk + to label attribution expectations.

tick_offset.description: Ticks after T_inject at which this delta activates. Step-function semantic: latest applicable offset wins.

delta_kind.description: Architect D4 refinement — delta scale discriminator. absolute: native units; relative_to_baseline_sigma: σ-multiplier (pairs with Family A δ_min σ-multiplier pattern); relative_to_baseline_mean: fraction of mean (for cost/throughput proportional shifts).

delta.description: Magnitude; interpretation depends on delta_kind. Signed — positive inflates signal, negative deflates. Units: native (absolute), σ (relative_to_baseline_sigma), fraction-of-mean (relative_to_baseline_mean).

family.description: Expected firing family for shadow-compare attribution check.

signal.description: Optional: expected firing signal (for Family A single-signal attribution).
